info.name: AyurMedi Backend APIs - Extended Modules
info.description:
Extended API collection for Ayurmedi Hospital Management System

## Modules Included:
- 🩺 Consultations
- 📋 Prescriptions
- 🌿 Panchakarma Treatments
- 💰 Billing & Payments
- 💊 Inventory Management
- 📊 Reports & Analytics
- 🏢 Branch Management
- 🎫 Token & Queue Management

## Prerequisites:
1. Import the main AyurMedi_API_Collection.json first
2. Import AyurMedi_Environment.json
3. Run the Login request to get authentication token

## Notes:
- These APIs are deployed and tested but not included in the main collection for brevity
- All APIs follow the same authentication pattern
- Response format is consistent across all endpoints

item.name: 🎫 Token & Queue

request.description:
Generate a new token for patient consultation

**SRS Module**: Token & Queue Management
**Required Fields**: patient_id, doctor_id
**Auth Required**: Yes (Receptionist)
**Response**: Token details with number

Get current queue status

**SRS Module**: Token & Queue Management
**Auth Required**: Yes
**Response**: Array of tokens in queue

Update token status (WAITING, IN_CONSULT, COMPLETED, etc.)

**SRS Module**: Token & Queue Management
**Required Fields**: status
**Auth Required**: Yes (Receptionist/Doctor)

Get current token display information (public endpoint)

**SRS Module**: Token & Queue Management
**Auth Required**: No (public display)
**Response**: Current token information for display

item.description: Token generation and queue management for patient flow.
